body: تجربة استثنائية أعرب النجم الشاب حمزة عبد الكريم، مهاجم نادي برشلونة، عن سعادته الكبيرة بالمشاركة والتسجيل أمام فريقه السابق الأهلي، في المباراة الودية التي جمعت الفريقين على ملعب سبوتيفاي كامب نو ضمن كأس خوان جامبر. وشهدت المباراة حضوراً جماهيرياً كبيراً، وندية تكتيكية عالية بين بطل إسبانيا وبطل إفريقيا، قبل أن يحسم البلوجرانا الأفضلية بثنائية في الشوط الأول عن طريق حمزة عبد الكريم ورافينيا، فيما قلص الأهلي الفارق مع بداية الشوط الثاني بواسطة أحمد مصطفى زيزو. وقال حمزة في تصريحات مع الصحفي القريب من برشلونة أشرف بن عياد عقب اللقاء: "الحمد لله، طبعاً إحساس مختلف، سعيد بأنني ألعب في الكامب نو، ليلة خاصة جداً بالنسبة لي". وعن مواجهة فريقه السابق، أكد المهاجم الشاب أن المشاعر كانت مختلطة، مشيراً إلى أن اللعب أمام الأهلي وفي ملعب بحجم كامب نو يمثل تجربة استثنائية في مسيرته. وتحدث حمزة عن أسابيعه الأولى مع الفريق الأول لبرشلونة تحت قيادة المدرب هانز فليك، قائلاً: "الحمد لله يمنحني ثقة كبيرة، سجلت أهداف وتأقلمت بشكل جيد مع المجموعة". ووجه حمزة رسالة شكر إلى الجماهير العربية التي ساندته خلال اللقاء، قائلاً: "شكراً والله، الجمهور يستاهل النهاردة". وكان حمزة عبد الكريم قد سجل هدفاً لبرشلونة في شباك الأهلي ورفض الاحتفال احتراماً لناديه السابق، قبل أن يسجد شكراً لله. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات …

summary: النجم البرازيلي سجل هدفًا من ركلة جزاء في شباك شوبير

title: تطور مفاجئ.. موسى ديابي خارج أسوار الاتحاد
summary: الجناح الفرنسي كان أحد أبرز نجوم "النمور" في العامين الماضيين

title: Samsung raises advanced foundry prices by up to 15% as AI demand fills its 4nm lines, report claims — Chinese customers accepting the largest hikes
summary: Samsung raised prices on new orders across its 4nm, 5nm, and 8nm foundry processes in July, with increases reaching 15% for customers in China.
body: Samsung raised prices on new orders across its 4nm, 5nm, and 8nm foundry processes in July, with increases reaching 15% for customers in China and the U.S., Reuters has reported, citing two people familiar with the matter. Chinese chip designers, cut off from advanced chipmaking tools by U.S. export controls, are accepting the largest hikes, and Samsung's 4nm line at Pyeongtaek has reportedly been running at full capacity since late last year. title: Player builds working AI chatbot in vanilla Minecraft using 445K command blocks — clever approach shrank initial block count from over 1 million, requires no mods, plugins, or datapacks to work
summary: Building neural networks in Minecraft using redstone is a relatively common pursuit, but a clever creator has worked around the limitations of command blocks' available math operations to implement an LLM in just 445,782 blocks, down from over a million in the initial implementation.
body: Anyone who's played Minecraft for a while is familiar with community creations like in-game graphing calculators, QR code generators, and Tetris games built using command blocks, mods, and far too much free time. Building AI tools is a logical next step, and several complicated projects have arisen in that vein using redstone. Reddit user Objz, however, implemented an LLM using only 445,782 command blocks and no mods, plugins, or datapacks. By its creator's description, the project was "a headache." Objz's LLM isn't actually that large. It only has a 64-dimensional embedding space, a 256-neuron hidden layer, and a tiny vocabulary of 2,048 words, and was trained on 11,118 DailyDialog conversations. Users can talk to it using the game's "/dialog" functionality, and the output stream comes back one word at a time, as with typical chatbots. Even with that training, however, the author notes that this LLM is only conversational and isn't particularly clever, as it cannot do math and has no broad knowledge. title: How to choose a new motherboard without overpaying — scoping out the features you need, and what you might never use as component costs soar
summary: How much motherboard is too much? We look at what you actually get as prices climb — from VRMs and connectivity to premium features and diminishing returns.
body: Buying a motherboard today can be a daunting task. There are more options than ever, with more features than ever, making it harder to know what you really need. Prices have also climbed consistently over the last several generations, with flagship motherboards now routinely costing as much as a high-end CPU or graphics card. Modern motherboards range in price from under $100 for the most basic, to well over $1,000 for flagship/Halo-type boards from the ‘Big 4’ (Asus, ASRock, Gigabyte and MSI). But more expensive doesn’t always mean a better experience, especially if you’re likely not to use the hardware and features you’re paying for. Several factors drive motherboard pricing. One such possibility is making actual working rocket engines, as Indian startup Othisis just demonstrated with a stationary test- fire of its fully cryogenic rocket engine, after a few failed attempts. As a broad description, SLM printers work by depositing a layer of microscopic metal powder on a base, and then firing a laser that melts the powder into solid at specific places. The base then drops down a fraction of a millimeter, a new layer of powder is deposited, and the process repeats.
